description: Modify the usage of the zone joint results logic. This logic allows for a reduced version of the model state at different instances of time to be output as binary files. The zone joint result can be used to re-create the model state, acting as a utility for efficient post processing (e.g., movie generation, residence time calculations, etc.). A zone joint result file DOES NOT replace a save file and models re-created with this logic should not be cycled. See the model results command to specify when results files are created and how to import these files subsequently.
notes: Documented in the 'wad' (wall-and-discontinuity) doc tree, not under flac3d/ -- which is why this family is absent from the FLAC zone corpus.
Live-probed on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14). Availability in FLAC3D is unverified.

keywords.name: active
keywords.description: Set the status of zone joint result creation (default false).

keywords.name: extra
keywords.description: Set the status of extra variable addition to results files (default false).

keywords.name: group
keywords.description: Set the status of group addition to results files (default false).

keywords.name: model
keywords.description: Set the status of contact model addition to results files (default true). If set to false, the null mechanical contact model is inserted in the place of the current contact model.
